notes.title: Update #13 | A lot of polish and finishing the full game!
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883660/90f1a327dcfcaad5d3ad8cbd0707d1a38efea3b1.png"]

List of changes:  

* 7th-12th main weapons and their unlockable conditions added to the full game.

* New enemy added to the first stage - Lost rock.

* New version of the turret enemy added for stage 2.

* New turret enemy added for stage 4.

* Visual polish: Menu navigation now uses scroll bars instead of arrows.

* Visual polish: "Ship stats" now includes every stat that you can get from upgrades. 

* Visual polish: "Ship stats" now has tooltips. 

* Visual polish: Now there is a button to reset settings.

* Visual polish: Now there is "My ship" button at the main view of the space station. 

* Visual polish: Ability cooldowns are now shown in ship simulator.

* Visual polish: Shop item rotation lock now displays if the items are locked or not.

* Visual polish: Enemy hp bar size now depends on enemy size.

* Visual polish: Now player hp is visible above the ship (can be disabled in options).

* Small gameplay tweak: Getting to a new stage no longer unlocks locked store items.

* Small gameplay tweak: Random floating drops' gold increased from 10 to 20.

* Small gameplay tweak: Danger meter effect doubled to 2 percent per travel.

* Small gameplay tweak: Item price and after-level rewards increased by 50%.

* Small gameplay tweak: Burst fire base damage increased from 8 to 9, and upgrade's damage boost from 2.5 to 3.

* Small gameplay tweak: Added level areas in all stages where you have to fight enemies instead of avoiding obstacles. 

* Small gameplay tweak: Reduced level areas where it is very hard to avoid obstacles in all stages.

* Small Visual polish: Eliminator upgrade's description improved.

* Small Visual polish: Missile upgrade's typo fixed.

* Small Visual polish: "Reload speed" stat's grammar error fixed. 

* Small Visual polish: Burst wave's icon updated.

* Bug fix: ability cooldowns not reset when starting or ending a level. 

* Bug fix: circle fire ability sometimes leaves the effect's sprite visible even the ability has finished.

* Bug fix: sometimes when upgrading passive items, the wrong tier would be moved, selected or final item would end up in the opposite place. 

* Bug fix: sometimes, when upgrading active items, an item would get corrupted, and the game would crash later.

* Bug fix: explosion does not destroy itself when switching between levels. 

* Bug fix: sometimes the game would crash while generating a galaxy. 

* Bug fix: active defense ability sometimes would make the game crash.

notes.title: Update #12 | Reworked upgrade system, and more!
notes.notes:
List of changes:  * new passive upgrade: Internal flame - Damaging enemies causes them to overheat and take 3 damage over the next 3 seconds.

* new active upgrade: Burst waves - Fire two waves of laser blasts (9 blasts). Each blast deals 8 damage.

* Item tears introduced that give extra bonuses: basic, bronze, silver, gold.

* Active upgrade system reworked. Now, combining upgrades allows you to pick an upgrade path, and the next time you'll upgrade, you will add power on top of it by choosing another path. 

* Each active ability now has a unique passive that appears when item tear is higher than basic. 

* Item price and level rework - you will not get higher-level items in shops or rewards, but the rarity of items will differ. 

* No limit on active ability levels

* Shield ability now has a sound effect

* UI improvement: Now item tooltips show item price and rarity

* Balance change: Damage to player reduced by 20 percent.

* Bug fix: damage numbers above enemies were rounded up wrongly

* Bug fix: advanced penetration now scales better with laser ability and plasma ball ability. Calculating as bonus damage per second. 

* Bug fix: piercing multiple enemies keeps reducing damage by 3x

* Bug fix: when killing an enemy with an attack that has pushback, the damage counter would fly away

notes.title: Update #11 | New enemies, boss music and more!
notes.notes:
List of changes:

* Flying back/left is now made 15 percent faster to make it feel nicer.

* Defensive turret reworked into attack drone ability

* Bug fix: a star that is beyond the boss star and unreachable

* Case simulator: Now player can move + no damage can be taken in simulation

* Balance: ship inventory increase price reduced by 50 percent.

* Bug fixed: rocks giving 2x gold

* Bug fixed: Double cannon firing only one bullet at the start of the level sometimes, and on simulator + double cannon delay of firing when first loading a level

* Temporary buffs will no longer spawn at the end of the level, where it is impossible to reach. It will still drop close to the end, though, where reaching is hard. 

* Upgrades can now be switched places in the grid or the inventory.

* Bug fixed: case simulator background would clip/cut out

* Option to reset tutorial added to the options menu

* Game icon and name updated on Windows, so that it would show Dangerous Galaxy instead of "make with GameMaker".

* Repair kit upgrade changed into active ability - healing pulse

* Now you can buy upgrades in the shop by pressing on them, as well as by pressing on the buttons. 

* Shop now includes a way to buy a connector upgrade and lock shop items

* Enemy ranged ships' health increased by 10.

* Rewards between levels increased. 

* Shop UI improved - some numbers were not aligned

* When picking a reward in gthe alaxy map with one inventory slot remaining, it no longer shows "storage is full". Now it shows the item itself. 

* Improved stage 1 to have fewer rock blockades and tunnels to have at least a few small asteroids to shoot

* Eliminator upgrade reworked - now it gives 0.5 percent damage for each point of damage you deal during an attack. So if you deal 20 damage, with a level 1 eliminator, you will deal 22 damage. 

* Inventory now has a slot where you can drag an item to sell

* Increased performance when spawning enemies and on collisions

* 2 new spinner enemies added to the game (and the demo).

* Boss music added.

notes.title: Update #6 | Procedurally generated levels, galaxy map, main weapons and more
notes.notes:
Increasing replayability

This update focuses on increasing the fun of replaying the game. We are introducing: an ability to unlock new main weapons, many new ship upgrades, procedurally generated levels, and more. We are also introducing some quality-of-life features: damage number indicators, offscreen enemy warnings, expanded tutorials, and more. 

Procedural generation


 Each stage of the game features a procedurally generated galaxy travel map. 
 As you travel through the galaxy, it becomes more dangerous. 
 Locations with treasure may lead you astray. 
 Each level is never the same - now it's procedurally generated (except the boss battles).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883660/78892af00669c51c6f5e576f38acace97c76484d.png

More ship customization


 The game now offers an ability to unlock new main weapons.
 8 new ship upgrades were added to the game. 
 Passive ship upgrades now can be upgraded unlimited amount of time.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44883660/db21a58f75302beead39c3d4fb2db7abfe1cff08.png

Like what you see? Try the demo - it's free!

notes.title: Update #1 | More ways to destroy
notes.notes:
This Dangerous Galaxy update includes many changes and additions aimed to increase variety and make the game more fun. 

Big updates:


 Level 11 was added to the game.
 Shipyard now allows to see the player's ship in real time, while the player adds upgrades to it. As well as an asteroid launch option to test your weapons.
 Damaging an enemy now shows a health bar on top of it.
 Roguelite elements were added to the game - after death, you can keep up to three upgrades.
 A new enemy was added to the game - spike shooter.
 2 new active abilities were added to the game: gravity wave and active defense.


Other updates:


 Many balance changes and minor upgrade changes.
 Minor gameplay bug fixes (including physics bugs)
